summary: Banco Santander Chile filed a Form 6-K (home-country equivalent of a US Form 8-K current report) disclosing that alternate director Alfonso Gómez Morales submitted a resignation letter to the Chairman with immediate effect, citing personal reasons. The resignation was reported under Chile's Law No. 18,045 Material Fact regime via the CMF on September 10, 2026. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or recommendation is stated; the filing is a single-sentence governance disclosure. Watch for a replacement alternate-director appointment, any committee reassignment, and whether further board turnover signals broader governance change.
